title: Two Hours of Life Changing
simplified_paragraphs: 在一次同学聚会上，有一位同学引起了大家的注意，因为他的事业非常成功。但是，在大家以前的印象中，这位同学不是一位优秀的人，成绩和各方面的能力都很一般。
后来，有人问他：”你成功的秘诀是什么？”他回答：”其实也没什么，只是我把大部分时间用在了做一件事情上。”
原来，大学毕业后，他每天都会拿出两个小时来学习企业管理。几年后，他开了自己的公司。因为有丰富的积累，他的公司很快就变得越来越大。
traditional_paragraphs: 在一次同學聚會上，有一位同學引起了大家的注意，因為他的事業非常成功。但是，在大家以前的印象中，這位同學不是一位優秀的人，成績和各方面的能力都很一般。
後來，有人問他：”你成功的秘訣是什麼？”他回答：”其實也沒什麼，只是我把大部分時間用在了做一件事情上。”
原來，大學畢業後，他每天都會拿出兩個小時來學習企業管理。幾年後，他開了自己的公司。因為有豐富的積累，他的公司很快就變得越來越大。
pinyin_paragraphs: zài yī cì tóng xué jù huì shàng， yǒu yī wèi tóng xué yǐn qǐ le dà jiā de zhù yì， yīn wèi tā de shì yè fēi cháng chéng gōng。 dàn shì， zài dà jiā yǐ qián de yìn xiàng zhōng， zhè wèi tóng xué bù shì yī wèi yōu xiù de rén， chéng jì hé gè fāng miàn de néng lì dōu hěn yī bān。
hòu lái， yǒu rén wèn tā：” nǐ chéng gōng de mì jué shì shén me？” tā huí dá：” qí shí yě méi shén me， zhǐ shì wǒ bǎ dà bù fen shí jiān yòng zài le zuò yī jiàn shì qing shàng。”

yuán lái， dà xué bì yè hòu， tā měi tiān dōu huì ná chū liǎng gè xiǎo shí lái xué xí qǐ yè guǎn lǐ。 jǐ nián hòu， tā kāi le zì jǐ de gōng sī。 yīn wèi yǒu fēng fù de jī lěi， tā de gōng sī hěn kuài jiù biàn de yuè lái yuè dà。
english_paragraphs: At a class reunion, one former classmate caught everyone’s attention because he had become very successful in his career. But as they remembered him, he had never been an outstanding student. His grades and abilities had been fairly average.
Later, someone asked him, “What’s the secret to your success?” He replied, “There’s really no secret. I just spent most of my time on one thing.”

It turned out that after graduating from college, he had set aside two hours every day to study business management. A few years later, he started his own company. With all the knowledge he had gained, his company quickly grew larger and larger.
english_full:
At a class reunion, one former classmate caught everyone’s attention because he had become very successful in his career. But as they remembered him, he had never been an outstanding student. His grades and abilities had been fairly average.

Later, someone asked him, “What’s the secret to your success?” He replied, “There’s really no secret. I just spent most of my time on one thing.”

It turned out that after graduating from college, he had set aside two hours every day to study business management. A few years later, he started his own company. With all the knowledge he had gained, his company quickly grew larger and larger.
